messages:
Samira Patel: Hey team — first week here! I'm trying to get set up for Dedicated GPU access and request VPC peering for a Private deployment. Who owns RBAC for Dedicated clusters and who approves peering? Also who do I page for Dedicated capacity incidents?
Eli Wong: Welcome Samira :wave: For RBAC ping @Binh in #eng-platform. For VPC peering & compliance that goes to @Priya in security. Oncall for Dedicated is the `infra-oncall` rotation (PagerDuty).
Binh Tran: Hi Samira — I can add your account. What's the service account name you'll be using and do you need S3 read/write?
Samira Patel: svc-samira-ml — I need read/write to `model-artifacts-prod` for eval snapshots.
Binh Tran: Got it. I'll add `svc-samira-ml` to the `dedicated-access` role and grant the S3 perms. Should be done in ~15m, I'll reply here when complete.
Priya Kaur: Quick note on peering: we need CIDR ranges, a short security justification, and a ticket in the security queue. Use the VPC peering template: https://redwood.internal/security/vpc-peering-request. If this blocks a customer launch mark it P0.
Samira Patel: Thanks — I'll file the ticket now. Do Private deployments also need a signed support/contract step?
Eli Wong: For full private-prod deployments we need Legal + Sales signoffs before any network changes that expose infra. For onboarding/dev peering it's usually just Security approval, but I'll loop Sales if this is customer-facing.
onboarding-bot: ✨ Reminder: submit the infra access form at https://onboard.redwood/infra within 24h to avoid delays.
Binh Tran: Done — `svc-samira-ml` added to `dedicated-access` and S3 policy attached. Samira, you should be able to run `aws s3 ls s3://model-artifacts-prod/` now.
Samira Patel: Confirmed, can list and upload — thanks so much! One last q: who owns pager escalation for Dedicated if the service is degraded?
Eli Wong: Primary owner is Platform Eng (pager: `platform-oncall`), backup is Eng SRE (`eng-sre-oncall`). Use the runbook in /docs/dedicated/runbook for steps.
Samira Patel: Perfect. Appreciate the quick help everyone :raised_hands:
